newsitem.title: USA: First Chicago NBD unit offers certificates.
newsitem.headline: First Chicago NBD unit offers certificates.

text.p: FCC National Bank, a subsidiary of First Chicago NBD Corp, said Friday it offered $900 million of floating-rate Class A certificates backed by credit card receivables.

The certificates were offered through a management group that includes Salomon Brothers Inc, First Chicago Capital Markets Inc, Chase Securities Inc, CS First Boston, Lehman Brothers and Merrill Lynch & Co.
The Series Q Class A certificates are priced at par and bear interest at a rate 13 basis points over the one-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
The initial interest rate for the September 25 through October 14 period will be determined on September 23. After that, the interest rate will be reset monthly.
Net proceeds of about $897 million will be used by FCC for general corporate purposes.
